::: {}
BIGr provides genomic and pedigree analysis functions designed for diploid and polyploid breeding programs. It also serves as a computational foundation for workflows exposed through BIGapp.

{{< tool-tags >}}
:::
<img class="software-logo" src="../assets/software-bigr.png" alt="BIGr logo">
:::

## Start here

```r
install.packages("BIGr")
library(BIGr)
```

[<i class="bi bi-box-seam" aria-hidden="true"></i> CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=BIGr){.btn-bi-secondary}

## Good fit for

- Genotype processing and format conversion
- Diploid and polyploid genomic analyses
- Workflows that also feed BIGapp
